source.title: Storm Dust - firsthand green blacksmith pickaxe DE comment
source.author: Roo42uk

quote: You can get Storm Dust from Disenchanting the green Pickaxes
notes: Firsthand Wowhead comment reports that a green blacksmith-crafted pickaxe yielded Storm Dust, without a specific item ID, rank, stack, count, build, skill or specialization. Proficient Pickaxe 222481 is a confirmed Khaz Algar Blacksmithing mining tool with Wowhead item-specific Disenchanting (3) index: https://www.wowhead.com/item=222481/proficient-pickaxe. Exact equivalence of the anonymous pickaxe and this particular ID is NOT proven; treat as candidate tool-family identity / eligibility only. The '3' in Wowhead Disenchanting (3) is a UI related-entry count, NOT 3 actual casts.
